sources.snippet: Reflection's 501B Beam with its full 1,048,576-token context, sized for one 128 GB DGX Spark. The 1.0 TB BF16 checkpoint becomes about 99.9 GB of GGUF parts: 98.3 GB that stay resident and a 1.56 GB BF16 token table that is read in rows from SSD. sources.title: unsloth/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: License: Apache 2.0 | Authors: Reflection Beam is an open model built by Reflection. Beam takes text as input and generates text as output. This release includes the instruction-tuned model in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 numerics. Beam uses a sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 501B total parameters and 23B active parameters.
